newsitem.title: USA: Energen to use short term borrowing.
newsitem.headline: Energen to use short term borrowing.

text.p: Energen Corp will use short term borrowing to fund the purchase of Burlington Resources Inc's San Juan Basin reserves, spokeswoman Julie S. Ryland said Tuesday.
Earlier, Energn announced plans to purchase the reserves for $77.75 million.
Ryland said the company plans to repay the short term borrowings with the sale of $85 million of medium term notes later this year.
She noted this will be the third financing under a debt and equity shelf offering filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission last fall.

Ryland said the purchase is part of Energen's previously announced plans to spend $400 million on acquisitions over five years through 2000 and another $100 million developing the properties acquired.
The company expects to fund about $250 million of this spending with cash flow, she said.
